checks: two authenticated roles, QA bot identity and local storage
environment source appears in the shared indexing registry and indexes new media
normal legacy access accepts the indexing source and rejects the unconfigured source
saved File Channels list restores the original legacy URL without enabling indexing
add_channel updates Indexing Channels and immediately indexes new posts
an indexing source supports batch retrieval without a File Channels entry
remove_channel updates settings and stale bootstrap values cannot revive the source
toggle_channel shares the same persisted indexing state
Indexing Channels edits replace the active set and change actual automatic indexing
public creation uses real membership outside both source lists; its stored grant delivers
public mode does not bypass normal-user legacy source checks, including private logs
live.settings_edits: Real settings service, followed by configuration sync and handler refresh; no new full settings-keyboard pass claimed.
live.public_creator_role: Temporarily removed source-member actor from configured QA ADMINS; real Telegram membership verified. No Telegram roles changed.

policy.indexing: One indexed_channels registry, shared by commands and Indexing Channels; environment/stored CHANNELS bootstrap missing IDs only.
policy.file_channels: Additional batch-only sources, normalized list; no automatic indexing.
policy.public_creation: Enabled public store plus source membership; no indexing/File Channels allowlist. Configured admins bypass membership.
policy.legacy: Normal users require an active indexing source or File Channels entry; configured admins retain source bypass.
policy.removal: Persist disabled registry entry with history to prevent bootstrap resurrection.
policy.existing_opaque_grants: Remain valid independently of source-list edits.
